name: Chance's Lucky Escape 2
summary:
Chance is still on the run, but the net is closing in. Can he stay one step ahead before the authorities finally catch him?

The story continues! This new point-and-click adventure picks up right where the first game, Chance's Lucky Escape, left off.

Chance managed to escape... but he's still not safe. The authorities are closing in and every lead brings them closer.

Guide Chance through a brand-new series of chapters filled with puzzles and exploration as he tries to escape, again.
